method_definitions.GOVERNED_NAME_OR_ALIAS: the source's venue name equals a census canonical name or a RETAINED alias
method_definitions.GOVERNED_NAME_WITHOUT_VENUE_TYPE_SUFFIX: the source omitted a generic venue-type word the census name carries
method_definitions.SOURCE_CARRIED_EXTRA_VENUE_TYPE_SUFFIX: the source carried a generic venue-type word the census name does not
method_definitions.VENUE_TYPE_SUFFIX_DIFFERS_ON_BOTH_SIDES: both names carry a generic venue-type word, and they differ
method_definitions.GOVERNED_NAME_QUALIFIED_BY_CITY: the source qualified the census name with the venue's own city
method_definitions.SOURCE_ADDRESS_NAMES_CENSUS_VENUE: the source's own address text names the census venue, typically a named space within a larger site

confidence_definitions.HIGH: a governed name or alias match whose geography the source's own location evidence positively confirms, or an address that names the venue outright
confidence_definitions.MEDIUM: a unique governed match with agreeing but not confirming geography, or with no location evidence at all
confidence_definitions.REVIEW: ambiguous, conflicting, or unmatched — a human decision is required
